title: The Audrey phone messages

tellings.quote: most people don't know there was 80 over 80 phone calls, Audrey phone calls to all sorts of people.

plain: Sometime between 2000 and 2019, more than 80 phone calls are said to have come from a caller known as "Audrey" to all sorts of people. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron says this, passing on what he heard from others, among them Stan Romanek, a man who says he has had contact experiences, the journalist Paola Harris, and a man named Timothy Taylor. Cameron says most people don't know about the calls, and if they are what he suggests, someone or something was reaching out to many people at once by phone.
